content:
Ana: Quick pulse on Sapphire preview — they were given 10 seats but activity shows 1 active. @Lee any blockers?

Lee: Hey Ana, thanks for the ping. We're hung up on SSO + role mapping. Admins can't see the 'project' scope so invites land but users have no access. Security wants a short justification doc before we change mappings.

Brett: @Lee I can jump in to validate the mapping rules. Can you paste the current SAML attributes here? Also if we need to, I can prepare a one-page risk note for security.

Marta: I pushed the Sapphire mini-playbook (5 steps) to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/playbooks/sapphire-quick 99includes invite flow and 2 smoke tests.

ci-bot: deployment: preview/sapphire updated at 2026-03-19T15:02Z. Recent auth errors (403) written to /ci/logs/sapphire-auth-20260319.log

Lee: I'll DM the attributes. On the exec ask, could you also provide a concise success rubric we can show product leadership? They want simple KPIs not raw telemetry.

Ana: Drafting a compact rubric now: success = 8 active seats OR 150 API calls/day for 7 consecutive days, admin checklist completed, and 3 sample prompts meeting quality thresholds. If not achieved by day 20 we'll open renewal outreach. I'll make a 2-question feedback survey (ease + likelihood to recommend) and attach it.

Brett: For the smoke validation after role fix, here's the curl I use locally, I'll run it on the call once tokens are ready:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":6}'
```

Marta: Proposed plan: 1) Brett/Lee pairing tomorrow 9:30am PT to fix role mapping + produce security note, 2) Ana posts rubric + survey by EOD, 3) Sapphire finishes the 5-step checklist and confirms seat counts, 4) 7-day follow-up review.

Ana: I'll create the invite and tag the account as 'preview-watch' so Sales and Renewal ops see it. I'll upload the rubric and survey link here when ready.

Lee: Appreciate it — we'll prioritize the mapping window and confirm back after the pairing.

Ana: Thanks everyone, will post the materials shortly.
